name: flightpath
description: Automate GitHub Copilot with structured prompt workflows

languageModelTools.name: flightpath_queue_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get comprehensive status of the current FlightPath workflow queue, including metadata and all prompts with their execution state

languageModelTools.name: flightpath_append_queue
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Append prompts to the current FlightPath workflow queue. Use when you want to extend the workflow with additional tasks. Supports inserting after current position ('next') or at end of queue ('end').

prompt.description: The prompt text to add to the queue

prompts.description: Array of prompts to add to the queue

position.description: Where to insert prompts: 'next' (after current) or 'end' (at end of queue)

reason.description: Optional explanation for why these prompts are being added

enumDescriptions: Use Copilot CLI (command-line automation - DEFAULT, better reliability & control)
Use Copilot Chat window (UI automation - less reliable than CLI modes)
Use Claude Code CLI (Anthropic's Claude AI via command line)
Use Codex CLI (OpenAI's code-specialized CLI)
Use OpenCode CLI for multi-provider AI coding assistance
flightpath.harness.description: Choose which harness/framework to use for AI execution
flightpath.harness.markdownDescription:
Choose which harness (agent framework/CLI tool) to use for AI execution.

- **Copilot CLI** (default): Best reliability with GitHub Copilot
- **Claude CLI**: Uses Anthropic's Claude Code CLI
- **Codex CLI**: Uses OpenAI's Codex code-specialized CLI
- **Copilot Chat**: UI automation (less reliable than CLI modes)

flightpath.promptsDirectory.description: Directory containing prompt files relative to workspace root

flightpath.scriptTimeout.description: Timeout for end condition scripts in seconds
flightpath.scriptTimeout.markdownDescription: Maximum time in seconds to wait for end condition scripts to complete. Default is 30 seconds. Range: 5 seconds to 5 minutes.

flightpath.workflowsDirectory.description: Directory for generated workflow files (relative to workspace root)
flightpath.workflowsDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory where workflows created from templates are saved. Relative to workspace root. Default: `.flightpath/workflows`

enumDescriptions: YAML format - Recommended for human editing (multi-line strings, readable structure)
JSON format - Best for programmatic generation and CI/CD automation
flightpath.defaultWorkflowFormat.description: Default file format for new workflows
flightpath.defaultWorkflowFormat.markdownDescription: Default file format when creating new workflow files. **YAML** (default) is recommended for manual editing with natural multi-line prompts. **JSON** is best for automated generation and scripting.

flightpath.defaultWorkflowTemplate.description: Default template selected in 'New Workflow' dialog
flightpath.defaultWorkflowTemplate.markdownDescription: Default template selected when opening the **New Workflow** dialog. Use `custom:{filename}` for custom templates from `.flightpath/templates/`.
enumDescriptions: Empty 2-prompt workflow
Plan → Implement → Commit
Run tests and fix failures with retry
Plan → Implement → Review → Docs → Commit

flightpath.autoAttachFiles.description: Automatically attach files referenced with #file: syntax
flightpath.autoAttachFiles.markdownDescription: Automatically process `#file:` references in prompts and attach file content as XML. Disable to send prompts as-is without automatic file attachment.

flightpath.respectGitignoreForCompletion.description: Respect .gitignore files when showing file and symbol completions
flightpath.respectGitignoreForCompletion.markdownDescription:
When enabled (default), FlightPath excludes gitignored files from `@` file completions and `#` symbol completions. This filters out build artifacts, dependencies, and IDE config files.

Disable if you need to reference files in `.gitignore` (e.g., debugging build outputs, including error logs, referencing dependencies).

**Applies to:** Dashboard prompt editor and VS Code editor (when editing `.flightpath.yml` files).

**Toggle quickly:** Use checkbox in Settings panel → Session Settings (Quick Access).

flightpath.openPromptsInSecondGroup.description: Open prompt files in a separate editor group (right side)
flightpath.openPromptsInSecondGroup.markdownDescription: When enabled, prompt files open in the second editor group (right side) instead of the active editor. This keeps your main code files visible for `#selection` references while editing prompts.

flightpath.maxPromptExecutionTime.description: Maximum time in seconds for a single prompt (default: 3 hours, -1 for unlimited)
flightpath.maxPromptExecutionTime.markdownDescription: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a single prompt to complete. Default is **3 hours** (10800s). Use **-1** for unlimited timeout. Range: **-1** (unlimited) or **5 minutes** (300) to **24 hours** (86400). This catches hung prompts while allowing long-running operations.

flightpath.maxWorkflowExecutionTime.description: Maximum workflow execution time in seconds (default: 24 hours, -1 for unlimited)
flightpath.maxWorkflowExecutionTime.markdownDescription: Maximum total execution time for the entire workflow in seconds. Default is **24 hours** (86400s). Use **-1** for unlimited timeout. Range: **-1** (unlimited) or **1 hour** (3600) to **7 days** (604800). Ignored if `unlimitedMode` is enabled. This catches runaway workflows, especially with dynamic queues.

enumDescriptions: Open Copilot Chat in the panel (recommended)
Open Copilot Chat in an editor tab
Open Copilot Chat in a new window
flightpath.chatWindowLocation.description: [Chat Mode] Where to open GitHub Copilot Chat
flightpath.chatWindowLocation.markdownDescription: **Chat Mode Only.** Choose where to open GitHub Copilot Chat for automation. **Chat Panel** is recommended for most users.

flightpath.chatUseNativeAttachments.description: [Chat Mode] Use VS Code's native attachment commands instead of temp prompt files
flightpath.chatUseNativeAttachments.markdownDescription:
**Chat Mode Only.** When enabled, FlightPath uses VS Code's native `attachFile` and `attachSelection` commands and opens agent-specific chat windows. **Does not support skills** (VS Code has no native skill API).

When disabled (default), FlightPath builds temp prompt files with agent, skills, and context embedded — matching the CLI harness behavior for a uniform experience. Files are attached to chat and the prompt becomes "Follow instructions in prompt.md".

flightpath.forceAgentModeForChat.description: [Chat Mode] Force chat to switch to default agent mode before sending prompts
flightpath.forceAgentModeForChat.markdownDescription: **Chat Mode Only.** When enabled, FlightPath automatically switches chat to the default **Agent** mode before sending prompts. This prevents issues with **Ask** and **Plan** modes (which don't edit files), but overrides custom agent selections. **Disabled by default** to preserve your custom agent choices.

flightpath.defaultAgent.description: [All Modes] Default agent for new workflows (discovered from .agent.md files)
flightpath.defaultAgent.markdownDescription:
Default agent (`.agent.md` file) applied to new workflows. Agents are discovered from:
- User prompts: `%APPDATA%\Code\User\prompts\` (Windows) or `~/.config/Code/User/prompts/` (Linux/Mac)
- Workspace GitHub: `.github/agents/`
- Workspace Claude: `.claude/agents/`

Leave empty for default behavior. Set via the **Set as Default** button in the Settings panel. See [Custom Agents documentation](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/customization/custom-agents) for more info.

flightpath.defaultSkills.description: [All Modes] Default skills for new workflows
flightpath.defaultSkills.markdownDescription: Default skills applied to new workflows. Skills are discovered from `.flightpath/skills/` and `.claude/skills/` directories. Set via the **Set as Default** button in the Settings panel.

flightpath.omitAgentsAndSkillsOnResume.description: [All Modes] Omit agent and skill instructions when resuming an existing session
flightpath.omitAgentsAndSkillsOnResume.markdownDescription:
When enabled (default), agent and skill instructions are **not** injected into prompts that resume an existing session. This prevents duplicate instructions — harnesses already have the agent/skill context from the first message in the session.

Disable this if you need agent and skill instructions re-sent on every prompt regardless of session state.

flightpath.chatInactivityTimeout.description: [Chat Mode] Inactivity timeout in seconds for response detection
flightpath.chatInactivityTimeout.markdownDescription: **Chat Mode Only.** How long to wait (in seconds) without log activity before considering the Copilot Chat response as timed out. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes). Increase for very long-running responses.

flightpath.treatChatTimeoutAsSuccess.description: [Chat Mode] Treat inactivity timeout as successful completion
flightpath.treatChatTimeoutAsSuccess.markdownDescription: **Chat Mode Only.** When enabled (default), chat inactivity timeouts are treated as successful completions rather than errors. This is useful because Copilot may have finished responding but the log marker wasn't detected. When disabled, timeouts are treated as errors and stop the workflow.

flightpath.copilotChatModel.markdownDescription: **Chat Mode Only.** Default AI model for Copilot Chat. FlightPath will switch to this model before sending each prompt. Prompts can override with `"model": "..."`.

enumDescriptions: Opens a VS Code terminal where you can see output, interact if needed, and press Ctrl+C to stop immediately (recommended)
Runs in background process without visible terminal
flightpath.cliExecutionMode.markdownDescription:
**CLI Modes Only.** Where CLI commands execute.

- **Interactive** (default): Opens a VS Code terminal for visibility and immediate abort via Ctrl+C
- **Headless**: Runs silently in background process

**Note:** Headless mode without full permissions will auto-deny tool prompts, preventing the agent from acting.

flightpath.closeTerminalWhenPromptComple.description: [Interactive Mode] Close the terminal when each prompt completes
flightpath.closeTerminalWhenPromptComple.markdownDescription: **Interactive Mode Only.** When enabled, automatically closes the VS Code terminal after each prompt finishes. When disabled (default), the terminal stays open so you can review the output before the next prompt starts.

flightpath.showCliOutput.description: [CLI Modes] Show CLI output in the Output panel
flightpath.showCliOutput.markdownDescription: **CLI Modes Only.** Show CLI output (prompts, responses, statistics) in the **Output** panel for visibility during workflow execution. Disable for background-only execution.

flightpath.logRawCliOutput.description: [Debug] Log raw CLI output for debugging
flightpath.logRawCliOutput.markdownDescription: **Debug Mode.** Log raw unparsed output from all CLI harnesses (Copilot, Claude, Codex) to the Output panel. Useful for debugging parser issues. **Warning:** Extremely verbose, only enable when troubleshooting.

flightpath.enableDiagnosticLogs.description: [Support] Write diagnostic logs to .flightpath/logs/ for troubleshooting
flightpath.enableDiagnosticLogs.markdownDescription: **Support Mode.** Write diagnostic log files to `.flightpath/logs/` in your workspace. Enable this when troubleshooting issues or when asked by support. Logs include FlightPath extension activity, MCP server events, and CLI hook invocations. Log files older than 7 days are automatically cleaned up.

flightpath.showCliCommand.description: [CLI Modes] Show the full CLI command with all arguments in the dashboard
flightpath.showCliCommand.markdownDescription: **CLI Modes Only.** When enabled, displays the complete CLI command with all arguments and flags in the dashboard output. Useful for debugging CLI integration.

flightpath.cliAllowedTools.description: [CLI Modes] Tool patterns to allow when using custom tool permissions
flightpath.cliAllowedTools.markdownDescription:
**CLI Modes Only.** Tool patterns to allow when using **custom** tool permissions. Uses Copilot CLI format - automatically converted for Claude CLI.

**Default allows:** File writing, safe Git operations (status/diff/add/commit/log), package managers (npm/yarn/pnpm), Node.js execution.

**Copilot patterns:** `shell(git:*)`, `write`, `github`

**Claude equivalents:** `shell` → `Bash`, `write` → `Write`

**Note:** Claude has more granular tools (`Read`, `Edit`, `MultiEdit`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `LS`, `WebFetch`). You can use these directly in lowercase. See [CLI docs](docs/COPILOT_CLI_DESIGN.md) for pattern syntax.

flightpath.cliDeniedTools.description: [CLI Modes] Tool patterns to deny (takes precedence over allows)
flightpath.cliDeniedTools.markdownDescription:
**CLI Modes Only.** Tool patterns to deny (takes precedence over allows). Uses Copilot CLI format - automatically converted for Claude CLI.

**Default denies:** File deletion (rm/del/Remove-Item/rd/rmdir), privilege escalation (sudo), permission changes (chmod/chown), destructive Git operations (push/reset/checkout/clean), destructive container operations.

**Includes both Unix and Windows commands** for cross-platform protection.

**Examples:** `shell(git push)`, `shell(rm:*)`. See [CLI docs](docs/COPILOT_CLI_DESIGN.md) for pattern syntax.

**Note:** For Claude CLI, deny lists have known reliability issues. Consider using `allowAll` mode or rely on filesystem permissions for critical protection.

enumDescriptions: Allow all tools without restrictions - IGNORES deny list (Copilot: --allow-all-tools with no denies, Claude: --dangerously-skip-permissions)
Auto-grant all tools but respect deny list (Copilot: --allow-all-tools + denies, Claude: --permission-mode bypassPermissions + --tools default)
Auto-grant only specific tools from allow list (Copilot/Claude: uses cliAllowedTools + cliDeniedTools)
flightpath.cliToolPermissions.markdownDescription:
**CLI Modes Only.** Control which tools the CLI can use.

- **Allow All** (default, recommended): Auto-grants all tools but respects deny list for safe automation
- **Dangerously Allow All**: Bypasses ALL restrictions including deny list (use with caution)
- **Custom**: Auto-grants only specific tools from `cliAllowedTools` with `cliDeniedTools` applied

**Implementation:**
- Copilot: `--allow-all-tools` flag with optional deny patterns
- Claude: `--permission-mode bypassPermissions` with tool specifications

flightpath.copilotCliModel.markdownDescription: **Copilot CLI Only.** Default AI model for Copilot CLI mode. Prompts can override with `"model": "..."`. Models are discovered dynamically at runtime via `copilot help config`. **Claude Sonnet 4.5** (default) provides the best balance of performance and capability.

flightpath.copilotCliAllowAllPaths.description: [Copilot CLI] Allow access to any file path without confirmation
flightpath.copilotCliAllowAllPaths.markdownDescription: **Copilot CLI Only.** When enabled (default), uses `--allow-all-paths` to disable path verification and prevent interactive prompts. Disable for stricter security if you want to control file access per-session.

flightpath.copilotCliAllowedDirs.description: [Copilot CLI] Additional directories to allow access (beyond workspace)
flightpath.copilotCliAllowedDirs.markdownDescription: **Copilot CLI Only.** List of additional directory paths that Copilot CLI can access. Workspace folders are automatically included.

flightpath.copilotCliAdditionalArgs.description: [Copilot CLI] Extra CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set
flightpath.copilotCliAdditionalArgs.markdownDescription: **Copilot CLI Only.** Extra CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set. FlightPath continues to manage model, permissions, workspace dirs, and session flags normally. Tokens are injected before tool permission args. Prompt-level and workflow-level `additionalArgs` take precedence over this global setting. Example: `--autopilot --log-level debug`

enumDescriptions: Claude Sonnet - Best balance of speed and capability (recommended)
Claude Sonnet 1M Context - Extended context window (new)
Claude Opus - Most capable, best for complex tasks
Claude Haiku - Fastest, best for simple tasks
flightpath.claudeCliModel.markdownDescription: **Claude CLI Only.** Default AI model for Claude Code CLI. **Sonnet** (default) provides the best balance of speed and capability. Prompts can override this with `"model": "opus"` or `"model": "haiku"`.

flightpath.claudeCliAdditionalArgs.description: [Claude CLI] Extra CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set
flightpath.claudeCliAdditionalArgs.markdownDescription: **Claude CLI Only.** Extra CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set. FlightPath continues to manage model, permissions, workspace dirs, and session flags normally. Tokens are injected before tool permission args. Prompt-level and workflow-level `additionalArgs` take precedence over this global setting. Example: `--effort high --max-turns 10`

enumDescriptions: GPT-5.1 Codex Max - Most capable for deep reasoning
GPT-5.1 Codex - Recommended, optimized for code (default)
GPT-5.1 Codex Mini - Faster and cheaper, less capable
GPT-5.2 - Latest frontier model
GPT-5.1 - Broad world knowledge
flightpath.codexCliModel.markdownDescription: **Codex CLI Only.** Default AI model for Codex CLI. **gpt-5.1-codex** (default) is optimized for coding tasks. Prompts can override this with `"model": "gpt-5.2"` or other supported models.

flightpath.openCodeCliModel.description: [OpenCode CLI] Model for OpenCode CLI in provider/model format (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6). Run 'opencode models' to see available models for your configured providers.

flightpath.openCodeCliAdditionalArgs.description: [OpenCode CLI] Extra CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set
flightpath.openCodeCliAdditionalArgs.markdownDescription: **OpenCode CLI Only.** Extra CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set. FlightPath continues to manage model, session, and output format flags normally. Prompt-level and workflow-level `additionalArgs` take precedence over this global setting. Example: `--thinking true --variant fast`

enumDescriptions: Read-only file access
Write to workspace + allowed directories (recommended)
Unrestricted filesystem access (dangerous)
flightpath.codexSandboxMode.description: [Codex CLI] Sandbox mode for custom permission mode
flightpath.codexSandboxMode.markdownDescription: **Codex CLI Only.** Sandbox mode when `cliToolPermissions` is set to **custom**. **workspace-write** (default) allows writing to workspace and directories specified in `codexAllowedDirs`. Only applies when `cliToolPermissions` is **custom**.

enumDescriptions: Ask for non-trusted commands (safe list: ls, cat, sed, etc.)
Run all, ask only if command fails
Model decides when to ask (recommended)
Never ask, fully automated (dangerous)
flightpath.codexApprovalPolicy.description: [Codex CLI] Approval policy for custom permission mode
flightpath.codexApprovalPolicy.markdownDescription: **Codex CLI Only.** Approval policy when `cliToolPermissions` is set to **custom**. **on-request** (default) lets the model decide when to ask for approval. Only applies when `cliToolPermissions` is **custom**.

flightpath.codexAllowedDirs.markdownDescription: **Codex CLI Only.** Additional directories Codex can write to when `codexSandboxMode` is **workspace-write**. Only applies when `cliToolPermissions` is **custom** and `codexSandboxMode` is **workspace-write**.

flightpath.codexCliAdditionalArgs.description: [Codex CLI] Extra CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set
flightpath.codexCliAdditionalArgs.markdownDescription: **Codex CLI Only.** Extra CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set (exec-tier only). FlightPath continues to manage model, permissions, workspace dirs, and session flags normally. Tokens are injected before tool permission args. Prompt-level and workflow-level `additionalArgs` take precedence over this global setting. Example: `--skip-git-repo-check -c model_reasoning_effort=high`

flightpath.defaultMaxRetries.description: Default number of retries when retryPrompt is specified but maxRetries is not
flightpath.defaultMaxRetries.markdownDescription: Default number of retries to use when a `retryPrompt` is specified in an end condition but `maxRetries` is not explicitly set. Use `-1` for unlimited retries, `0` to disable default retries, or `1-100` for a specific limit. **Default: 3**

flightpath.defaultRetryPrompt.default:
**Validation Failed** (Attempt {retryCount}/{maxRetries})

**Expected:** `{expectedValue}`
**Actual:** `{actualValue}`

**Output:**
```
{scriptOutput}
```

Please fix the issues above and try again.
flightpath.defaultRetryPrompt.description: Default retry prompt template when maxRetries is specified but retryPrompt is not
flightpath.defaultRetryPrompt.markdownDescription: Default template for retry prompts when `maxRetries` is specified in an end condition but `retryPrompt` is not. Supports placeholders: `{scriptOutput}`, `{errorOutput}`, `{expectedValue}`, `{actualValue}`, `{retryCount}`, `{maxRetries}`. Leave empty to require explicit retry prompts.

enumDescriptions: No prior context injection (default)
Inject the previous prompt's output
Inject all prior prompt outputs
Inject all finalPrompt outputs
Inject the previous finalPrompt output
flightpath.priorContext.description: Default prior context injection mode for workflow prompts
flightpath.priorContext.markdownDescription: Default mode for injecting prior prompt outputs into subsequent prompts. Workflows and individual prompts can override this. `none` disables injection; `previous` injects only the preceding prompt's output; `all` injects all prior outputs; `finalPromptAll`/`finalPromptPrevious` target finalPrompt outputs specifically.

flightpath.resumeExistingSession.description: Resume existing chat session for each prompt in multi-prompt workflows
flightpath.resumeExistingSession.markdownDescription: When enabled, each prompt in a multi-prompt workflow continues in the existing chat session for context continuity. When disabled (default), each prompt starts a fresh chat session. Individual prompts can override this with `"resumeSession": true` in the JSON schema. Retries always use the same session regardless of this setting.

flightpath.enableDynamicQueue.description: [Dynamic Queue] Allow AI to extend workflow by adding prompts during execution
flightpath.enableDynamicQueue.markdownDescription: Allow the AI to extend the workflow by adding prompts to the `.flightpath.json` file during execution. This enables adaptive autonomous workflows where the AI can break down complex tasks dynamically.

flightpath.dynamicExtensionOnLastPrompt.description: [Dynamic Queue] Allow extension on last prompt when no explicit flags are set
flightpath.dynamicExtensionOnLastPrompt.markdownDescription: When dynamic queues are enabled, allow extension on the last prompt when no explicit `allowDynamicExtension` flags are set. Disable this if your last prompt should never extend the queue (e.g., 'commit changes').

flightpath.maxQueueSize.description: [Dynamic Queue] Maximum prompts allowed (prevents infinite loops)
flightpath.maxQueueSize.markdownDescription: Maximum number of prompts allowed in a dynamic queue (prevents infinite loops). Range: **1** to **1000**. Default: **100**. Ignored if `unlimitedMode` is enabled.

flightpath.unlimitedMode.description: [Dynamic Queue] Enable unlimited mode (no queue size or workflow time limits)
flightpath.unlimitedMode.markdownDescription: Enable unlimited mode: removes queue size and workflow execution time limits. When enabled, both `maxQueueSize` and `maxWorkflowExecutionTime` are ignored. **Note:** Individual prompts still respect `maxPromptExecutionTime` to catch hung processes (set it to -1 if you want truly unlimited). This feature may be restricted to paid tier in future releases.

flightpath.notifyOnQueueExtension.description: [Dynamic Queue] Show notification when AI extends the prompt queue
flightpath.notifyOnQueueExtension.markdownDescription: Show notification when the AI extends the prompt queue during workflow execution.

flightpath.autoLoadRecentSession.description: [Session Management] Automatically load the most recent workflow session on startup
flightpath.autoLoadRecentSession.markdownDescription: When enabled (default), FlightPath automatically loads the most recent workflow from `.flightpath/.queue/` when VS Code starts. This enables seamless resume after crashes or restarts. Disable if you prefer to manually select workflows.

flightpath.saveOutputHistory.description: [Output History] Save CLI output history for each workflow run. History is stored in .flightpath/.history/ and excluded from version control.

flightpath.maxHistoryRuns.description: [Output History] Maximum number of runs to keep per workflow. Older runs are automatically deleted. Use -1 or 0 to keep all runs (default).

flightpath.confirmDeleteOperations.markdownDescription: When enabled (default), FlightPath shows a confirmation dialog before deleting prompts or workflow history. Uncheck **"Don't ask me again"** in any delete dialog to disable. Re-enable here to restore confirmation prompts.

scripts.precompile: npm run generate-schema && npm run generate-icons && npm run generate-sidebar-icon
scripts.compile: npm run compile:extension && npm run compile:webview
scripts.compile:webview: npm run generate-custom-icons && vite build --config src/ui/webview-react/vite.config.ts --mode development
scripts.watch:webview: npm run generate-custom-icons && vite build --watch --config src/ui/webview-react/vite.config.ts --mode development
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:extension && npm run build:webview
scripts.build:extension: npm run check-types && node scripts/strip-dev-commands.mjs && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.build:webview: npm run generate-custom-icons && vite build --config src/ui/webview-react/vite.config.ts --mode production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && node esbuild.js
scripts.compile:prod: npm run compile:extension && npm run build:webview
